ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Eyebrow.helper: Short label above the heading. Keep this concise.

Heading.helper: Enter the heading to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Bullet1.helper: Enter the bullet1 to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Bullet2.helper: Enter the bullet2 to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Bullet3.helper: Enter the bullet3 to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Bullet4.helper: Optional. Enter a fourth bullet point to show below the other bullets.

Image.helper: Use a tall portrait-style image when possible. Recommended minimum size: 1200px wide by 1500px high.

ImageAlt.helper: Describe the image for accessibility and SEO.

ImagePosition.helper: Choose whether the image displays on the left or right on desktop.

QuoteText.helper: Optional quote or callout displayed overlapping the image.

ShowQuoteDesktopOnly.helper: Recommended. Hides the overlapping quote card on smaller screens.
